requirements.initial: Fresh isolated home; UTA intentionally unavailable.
requirements.action: Create Chat concurrently, run a controlled local Codex-protocol child, restart the service and resume.
requirements.expected: One durable Chat and native Session identity survive; local replies decode without a broker carrier.
